fixed.explanation: _retryAction waits between retries by evaluating a setTimeout promise in the page utility context. With JavaScript disabled, that evaluation never resolves, so the retry hangs. Replace it with a server-side setTimeout raced via progress.race.

query.intent: The action retry loop in the injected-script based click/action code waits between retries using a page-evaluated script (e.g. evaluating a requestAnimationFrame or setTimeout-based wait inside the page). That wait must be done without relying on page JavaScript, e.g. with a server-side timeout, so it works when JavaScript is disabled.
query.symptom: With JavaScript disabled in the browser context, a click that needs to retry hangs forever between retries.
